zh: 智能体工具权限收敛与状态联动：WeLink 频道消息（机器人推送）纳入团队默认关闭策略，与平台共享 MCP 保持一致；当底层频道未启用时自动对非超管隐藏，超管后台清晰标明连接状态。
WorkBuddy 桌面连接器会话解析增强：修复桌面智能体遇到字符串等非数组格式消息时报错中断的问题，自适应兼容多种原生会话结构与历史解析。
托管 Python 应用跨团队共享与访问治理：支持超级管理员将托管应用安全共享至指定团队或全员，严格隔离底层源码与平台鉴权，强化应用代码编辑与反向代理安全性。
登录页与媒体资源大厅跳转修复：修复未登录状态下点击登录页「影视作品」被重定向回登录界面的问题，支持免登录直接浏览公开点播大厅；统一后台媒体资源卡片操作按钮对齐与样式。
AI 月报保存网络容错优化：AiOps-Report 接口增加连接异常自动重试机制，有效抵御隧道代理抖动或 Keep-Alive 长连接回收导致的保存中断。
en: Agent tool access hardening & channel status linking: WeLink channel messaging (bot push) is now off for teams by default alongside shared MCP; tools are hidden from non-super admins when the channel is disabled.
WorkBuddy desktop connector session resilience: fixed conversation crashes caused by non-array teammate messages, adapting seamlessly across varied native chat structures.
Hosted Python app team sharing & governance: super admins can now securely share hosted applications across teams with strict source isolation, hardened code editing, and secure proxy authentication.
Login page & cinema navigation fixes: resolved an issue where clicking 'Cinema' on the login page redirected back to login, enabling direct guest access; standardized media resource button alignment.
AI monthly report network resilience: added automatic connection retry to AiOps-Report document saving to withstand transient tunnel flaps and keep-alive socket drops.
